lines.text: RAG. KV cache. Prompt injection. You've heard them. Ever seen one work?
RAG? It looks things up before it answers. KV cache? Notes the model keeps, so it never re-reads your prompt. Prompt injection? An email that tricks your assistant.
Quick test. Same message, English or Hindi. Which costs the model more tokens?
Hindi. Eighteen tokens to English's ten. Guess first, then see why. That's every chapter.
